## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Cūḷaniddesa-aṭṭhakathā* is the commentary on the *Cūḷaniddesa*, situated within the Khuddakanikāya commentary section (*Aṭṭhakathā Khuddakanikāya*) of the Pali commentarial literature [DharmaNexus; Dhammadinna 2014]. Within the provided research literature, the text is not discussed in detail but appears listed in abbreviation and reference lists alongside other canonical commentaries such as the *Paramatthajotikā*, *Papañcasūdanī*, and *Samantapāsādikā* [Dhammadinna 2014].

Computational analysis via DharmaNexus demonstrates widespread text reuse throughout the Pali commentarial and exegetical corpus, documenting 20,999 matching passages shared with 301 other Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. Its most significant alignment partner is the *Suttanipāta-aṭṭhakathā* (985 matches, 145,651 characters; with long passages such as §552_0–557_9 matching §259_0–264_9 at 0.95 similarity) [DharmaNexus]. It also shares extensive parallel material with the *Paṭisambhidāmagga-aṭṭhakathā* (871 matches, 117,628 characters), the *Mahāniddesa-aṭṭhakathā* (943 matches, 81,535 characters), the *Dhammasaṅgaṇi-aṭṭhakathā* (502 matches, 65,054 characters), the *Apadāna-aṭṭhakathā* (411 matches, 63,367 characters), the *Mūlapaṇṇāsa-aṭṭhakathā* of the Majjhima Nikāya, and both parts of the *Visuddhimagga* [DharmaNexus]. DharmaNexus records no cross-language matches with a score of 10 or greater [DharmaNexus].
